title: Mushroom & tomato omelette with toast
method: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and cook the mushrooms for 4 minutes until softened.
Beat the eggs in a bowl, stir in the diced tomato and pour into the pan.
Cook over a medium-low heat, lifting the edges so uncooked egg can run underneath, then scatter over the cheese.
Fold the omelette once the egg is set, toast the bread and serve together.

substitutions.note: Use a similar measured amount and check allergen labelling.
Choose a product suitable for your dietary needs.

storage.chilled: Best eaten freshly cooked. Refrigerate any cooked leftovers promptly and eat within 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Reheat once until piping hot throughout, although texture is best fresh.

food_safety: Cook the omelette until the egg is set; use appropriately marked eggs and follow current food-safety advice.

title: Breakfast bean & egg burrito
method: Drain and rinse the black beans, then warm them gently in a small saucepan or microwave until hot.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan, wilt the spinach, add the beaten eggs and scramble until just set.
Warm the wrap according to the packet instructions, then add the beans, scrambled egg, salsa and cheese down the centre.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly and serve immediately.

substitutions.note: Drain, rinse and heat thoroughly before using.
Choose a suitable product and check allergen labelling.

storage.chilled: Best assembled and eaten fresh. Refrigerate any unused cooked filling promptly and eat within 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Reheat leftover bean/egg filling once until steaming hot; assemble with a fresh wrap.

food_safety: Cook eggs until set and keep cooked filling hot until serving.

title: Turkey, cheddar & salad sandwich
method: Lay out the two slices of wholemeal bread and spread the mustard thinly over one slice.
Layer on the lettuce, tomato and cucumber.
Add the cooked turkey and measured cheese.
Top with the second slice of bread, press lightly and cut in half.

substitutions.note: Use an equivalent cooked portion and keep chilled.
Use a measured portion and check allergen labelling.

storage.chilled: Keep chilled and eat within 24 hours if made ahead.

food_safety: Use cooked poultry that has been stored safely and is within its use-by period.
Keep the prepared sandwich chilled until eating.

title: Lentil & tomato soup with wholemeal roll
method: Rinse the red lentils in a sieve until the water runs mostly clear.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes until starting to soften.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and smoked paprika, bring to a simmer and cook for 20–25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend some or all of the soup to your preferred texture, check it is piping hot and serve one quarter with a wholemeal roll.

substitutions.note: Choose a suitable product and check allergen labelling.
Use the same dry weight and cook until completely soft.

storage.chilled: Cool soup promptly, cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.
storage.freeze: Freeze cooled soup in individual portions without the roll.
storage.reheat: Defrost safely if frozen and reheat once until steaming hot throughout.

food_safety: Cool large batches promptly by dividing into smaller containers before refrigerating.

title: Beef & broccoli noodle stir-fry
method: Cook the noodles according to the packet instructions, drain and set aside.
Heat a large wok or frying pan until hot, add the sesame oil and stir-fry the beef for 3–4 minutes until browned.
Add the broccoli and pepper with a splash of water and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add the garlic, ginger and soy sauce, return the noodles and toss everything for 2 minutes until piping hot.
Divide between two bowls and serve immediately.

substitutions.note: Cook thoroughly until no pink remains.
Choose a suitable product and follow its pack instructions.

storage.chilled: Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate for up to 2 days.
storage.reheat: Reheat once in a pan or microwave until steaming hot throughout.

food_safety: Cook beef to your preferred safe doneness and avoid cross-contamination with ready-to-eat ingredients.
Cool noodle leftovers promptly before refrigerating.

title: Cod & pea fish pie

ingredients.item: skinless cod fillet, cut into chunks

method: Heat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan and boil the potatoes for about 15 minutes until tender, then drain and mash with 100ml of the milk.
Put the remaining milk and leek in a saucepan, bring gently to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with a splash of cold water, stir it into the milk until thickened, then add the cod, peas and parsley and cook gently for 4–5 minutes until the fish is nearly cooked.
Spoon the fish mixture into an ovenproof dish, top with the mash and measured cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden and make sure the fish is completely cooked before serving.

substitutions.note: Use an equivalent boneless portion and cook thoroughly.
Choose an option suitable for your dietary needs; sauce thickness may vary.

storage.chilled: Cool leftovers promptly, cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Reheat once until steaming hot throughout, checking the centre carefully.

food_safety: Check fish carefully for bones before cooking.
Cook fish completely and refrigerate leftovers promptly.

title: Hummus & crunchy veg pot
method: Wash the vegetables and cut them into easy dipping sticks.
Measure the hummus into a small lidded pot.
Pack the vegetables and crispbreads separately so they stay crisp.
Keep chilled until needed and dip the vegetables and crispbreads into the hummus.

substitutions.note: Use a measured portion and check allergen labelling.
Choose a product suitable for your dietary needs.

storage.chilled: Keep hummus and cut vegetables refrigerated and eat within 24 hours once packed.

food_safety: Wash raw vegetables thoroughly and keep opened hummus refrigerated.

title: Chocolate berry protein yoghurt
method: Stir the cocoa powder and honey thoroughly into the Greek yoghurt.
Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl or lidded pot.
Top with the sliced strawberries.
Sprinkle over the measured dark chocolate and eat immediately or keep chilled.

substitutions.note: Choose a suitable product and check allergen labelling.

storage.chilled: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 24 hours.

food_safety: Keep yoghurt refrigerated and wash berries before use.
